mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_consistency_report (item_id, initial_stock, bucket_sum, lease_held, stream_len, order_count, duplicate, dead_letter, oversold, undersold, passed, detail) VALUES (#{poolId}, #{initialStock}, #{bucketSum}, #{leaseHeld}, #{streamLen}, #{orderCount}, #{duplicate}, #{deadLetter}, #{oversold}, #{undersold}, #{passed}, #{detail})
mapper.select: SELECT id, item_id AS poolId, initial_stock AS initialStock, bucket_sum AS bucketSum, lease_held AS leaseHeld, stream_len AS streamLen, order_count AS orderCount, oversold, undersold, passed, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM t_consistency_report ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
